messages:
amanda.partnerships: Quick heads up 11 ResellCo's Azure marketplace onboarding is blocked by a PO/payment term. They insist on a 5% escrow wire in the PO and submitted MSA redlines. Can procurement + legal advise next steps?
caroline.procurement: On it. Do we have their exact PO language? Need the snippet to scope treasury risk.
amanda.partnerships: Copying what they uploaded to the vendor portal:
```PO clause: "Buyer shall remit 5% of total PO value to ResellCo Escrow Agent within 10 business days of PO acceptance. Escrow agent disburses on mutual acceptance between buyer and reseller."```
caroline.procurement: That mutual-acceptance trigger is the problem. Treasury won't wire to a third-party escrow without explicit SLA and indemnity. Also signer on the PO is a regional sales rep, not the legal entity on file.
sarah.legal: Reading their MSA redlines They converted our delivery-acceptance trigger into a mutual-acceptance escrow release. That exposes us to payment without verified delivery. Two options that look workable: (A) convert to a 5% invoice holdback tied to our acceptance tests, or (B) escrow addendum with escrow agent KYC + indemnity + limited disbursement triggers. Option A is fastest.
raj.sales: ResellCo claims Azure requires escrow for certain hardware SKUs in their region and marked it as a marketplace prerequisite. If we push back, marketing's joint launch next week will slip. Is a narrow carve-out possible?
lina-ps: Azure validation team flagged that the marketplace PO contract type doesn't support external escrow wiring flows. Their portal recommends an MSA addendum instead of changing the PO shape.
mike-ops: From ops: we won't enable the listing until vendor KYC and finance routing are cleared. If you pick addendum route, we need escrow agent KYC, proof of funds path, and indemnity language approved.
sarah.legal: Pragmatic proposal: ask ResellCo to accept a 5% invoice holdback on first invoice plus a purchase cap of $50k in the initial PO, and require an authorized signer from their finance/legal within 5 business days. If they accept, legal can sign off quickly.
caroline.procurement: Finance willing to accept holdback + cap pending entity verification. We'll also require an amended PO signed by an authorized officer.
vendor-bot: entity-match result: signer_name="R. Gomez (ResellCo Sales)"; registered_entity="ResellCo, Inc."; EIN MISMATCH FLAGGED; action: require authorized signer or board resolution.
raj.sales: Messaging ResellCo now to propose holdback + cap and ask for finance lead to sign. I'll ask for a 2448h turnaround.
amanda.partnerships: Can marketing keep launch date tentatively? If they won't accept holdback, we might need an addendum and that pushes timeline. Any chance of a private listing for partners to meet launch?
lina-ps: We can create a private/preview listing for select partners, but checkout will be disabled for unverified vendors. That might satisfy a soft announcement but won't allow general availability.
mike-ops: If amended PO + KYC land, ops can flip the listing from private to public quickly. No infra changes.
sarah.legal: I'll draft a concise PO amendment template and an escrow addendum fallback. Caroline, I'll send both drafts to you for quick review.
caroline.procurement: Thanks. Also confirm finance wiring rules for holdback release cadence.
raj.sales: ResellCo responded: they prefer escrow but will consider holdback if it's an interim measure. ETA from them: 36h to get authorized signer and confirm acceptance.
amanda.partnerships: Perfect. Action list: (1) Raj: secure signed amended PO with authorized signer and acceptance of 5% invoice holdback + $50k cap (48h), (2) Caroline: confirm finance holdback release flow and limits, (3) Sarah: prepare amendment + escrow addendum templates, (4) Lina: keep listing in staging/private mode until docs cleared, (5) Mike: stand by to enable public listing. I'll update marketing and pause the public announcement until we have the amended PO. :thumbsup:
raj.sales: Will follow up and post vendor docs here when received.
amanda.partnerships: Thanks all. Keeping thread open for vendor artifacts and vendor-bot KYC updates.
